headline: Meta launches enterprise AI platform, hires MongoDB CEO
summary: Meta launched a new enterprise AI platform and business, aiming to sell its Muse technology stack, including Meta Business Agent, Muse API and Muse Code, to other companies. Meta hired the MongoDB CEO to lead the new initiative. One outlet frames the move as an effort to justify Meta's AI spending.
